claims.claim_vi: Cassandra: on reads it merges data on disk with data in memory; to avoid checking every data file for the requested partition it uses a bloom filter, which says either that the data definitely does not exist in the file or that it probably does; accuracy improves with more memory and is tuned per table with bloom_filter_fp_chance.
claims.verified_by: Read from a raw copy at the pinned commit in the URL (a later change to the default branch does not alter it).

claims.claim_vi: Cassandra: naive hashing takes the key hash modulo the number of buckets and adding a node can invalidate almost all mappings; Cassandra maps each node to tokens on a continuous hash ring, hashes a key onto the ring and walks it in one direction; with consistent hashing only a small fraction of keys move when the number of nodes changes.
claims.section: Consistent Hashing using a Token Ring
claims.verified_by: Read from a raw copy at the pinned commit in the URL (a later change to the default branch does not alter it).

claims.claim_vi: etcd-io/raft: Raft is a protocol with which a cluster of nodes maintains a replicated state machine kept in sync by a replicated log; the library implements leader election and log replication among other features and implements only the Raft algorithm, leaving network and disk IO to the user.
claims.verified_by: Read from a raw copy at the pinned commit in the URL (a later change to the default branch does not alter it).
